Noah T: quick heads-up 8 ran a small speculative decode pass on the new 13B-lite with `q4_deadzone` + latebind=48. throughput up, some recall wobble on span-copy tasks.

Priya G: numbers?

Noah T: short: fp16 10.6 tok/s -> q4_deadzone+latebind 20.3 tok/s (1.91x). 95p latency increased ~30ms.

Omar H: how big is the quality hit? any metrics on our copy/recall set?

Noah T: 500-case copy test: exact-match down 1.5% abs, errors concentrated when target span >600 tokens away.

Priya G: did you run `kv_always_merge=false` ablation?

Noah T: not yet. planning ablation matrix: (1) q4 only, (2) latebind only, (3) q4+latebind, (4) q4+latebind + kv_merge=false.

Omar H: add per-token KL dump vs fp16 for tails. we need to see if mass shifts or just tokenization boundary effects.

Noah T: good call. will enable `dump_logits_diff=true` for tail positions >512.

ci-bot: CI: bench job queued (id bench-176666-01).

bench-bot: bench started on cluster-x (workers=8). artifacts -> /runs/bench-176666-01

Priya G: set acceptance gate: max EM drop 0.6% overall, <1.0% on copy-set. if ablation fails -> fallback to q4_no_deadzone.

Noah T: kicking off runs now, ETA ~6h. will attach eval-config and seeds. tagging @Omar H for logits analysis. :thumbsup:
